description: Cited active-metabolite pairs used only for duplication flags. Each pair quotes the FDA label sentence that states the relationship, with the label's set_id and effective_time. Base ingredient names are lowercase RxNorm ingredient (IN) names.
source: FDA drug labels through the openFDA Drug Label API (https://open.fda.gov/apis/drug/label/)

pairs.sentence: Desvenlafaxine (O-desmethylvenlafaxine) is the major active metabolite of the antidepressant venlafaxine, a medication used to treat major depressive disorder.
